{"people":[{"name":"Jordan","role":"Account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"PMM","role":"Product marketer (interviewer)","side":"us"},{"name":"Halima","role":"COO","side":"customer"},{"name":"Ben","role":"CTO","side":"customer"},{"name":"(unnamed)","role":"CEO","side":"customer"},{"name":"(unnamed)","role":"Named solutions engineer","side":"competitor"},{"name":"(unnamed)","role":"Account lead","side":"competitor"},{"name":"(unnamed)","role":"Our solutions engineer","side":"us"}],
"competitors":["Unnamed competitor (name never given in transcript)"],
"incumbent":"Unnamed previous payments provider whose support was a ticket form",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"tickets went live at 10am on a Friday, and payments started failing about four minutes in.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Concrete triggering event: payment failure during a big arena tour on-sale."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"Their provider's support was a ticket form. They got a reply after the on-sale was over.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Root pain was unresponsive support, not only the outage itself."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"The CEO was getting screenshots on social.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Public, executive-visible embarrassment escalated the issue."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"So Monday morning the COO, Halima, says they're replacing payments before the spring on-sales.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","decider"],"note":"COO initiated the evaluation; deadline tied to spring on-sales."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"Ben, their CTO, said twice.","label":"fact","speaker":"Ben (CTO), relayed by rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Failures had happened before; this one was different because of visibility."},
{"id":"E6","turn":4,"excerpt":"But this was the first time the CEO saw it.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Executive visibility, not the failure itself, triggered the evaluation."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"Halima. Ben wanted us. He told me that, and he told me he lost.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (reporting Ben)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","outcome"],"note":"Our champion (CTO) was overruled by the COO."},
{"id":"E8","turn":6,"excerpt":"it was Halima's call and she made it in one meeting.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ben (CTO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"Confirms Halima as sole decider and a fast decision."},
{"id":"E9","turn":6,"excerpt":"He called me before the official email went out","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Formal loss notification came by official email."},
{"id":"E10","turn":8,"excerpt":"They showed up with the people who'd actually be on the account. A named solutions engineer and an account lead, in the room.","label":"fact","speaker":"Ben (CTO), relayed by rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Competitor put named, real people in front of the buyer."},
{"id":"E11","turn":8,"excerpt":"they said there'd be a shared channel and someone on call for every major on-sale.","label":"fact","speaker":"Ben (CTO), relayed by rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Competitor's promise matched the buyer's on-sale support pain directly."},
{"id":"E12","turn":8,"excerpt":"I think they over-promised. I don't think anybody staffs every on-sale. But I don't know that.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep's unverified theory about the competitor; rep admits not knowing."},
{"id":"E13","turn":10,"excerpt":"Everything turned into \"who.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","language"],"note":"Customer's questions shifted after the competitor meeting."},
{"id":"E14","turn":10,"excerpt":"Who do I call at 10 on a Friday. Who's my person. What's the escalation path if that person's on holiday.","label":"fact","speaker":"customer questions, relayed by rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor","language","gaps"],"note":"Rep's rendering of the customer's new questions; not marked as verbatim."},
{"id":"E15","turn":10,"excerpt":"Before that meeting it was throughput, queueing, bots. After, it was names.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","decided"],"note":"The turning point came at the competitor meeting, before the moment the rep named."},
{"id":"E16","turn":12,"excerpt":"Ben's team ran a load test in the sandbox and it went great.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Our technical proof landed with the CTO's team."},
{"id":"E17","turn":12,"excerpt":"The uptime history, the docs. The bot and fraud tooling got a good reaction too.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Rep's read that the technical messages resonated."},
{"id":"E18","turn":12,"excerpt":"who's my person","label":"quote","speaker":"Halima (COO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language","gaps"],"note":"Decider's core question was about a person, not product."},
{"id":"E19","turn":12,"excerpt":"I walked her through the support plans. The tiers, the response times.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Our answer used tiered-support language that did not fit the question."},
{"id":"E20","turn":12,"excerpt":"so it's a queue with a faster timer.","label":"quote","speaker":"Halima (COO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decided","language"],"note":"Decider dismissed our support offer as no different from the failed incumbent."},
{"id":"E21","turn":14,"excerpt":"Right before it we were the favourite.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep's belief, at odds with the earlier shift toward 'who' questions."},
{"id":"E22","turn":14,"excerpt":"Ben had basically told his team to start planning the integration.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decided","decider"],"note":"Hedged ('basically'); the champion's enthusiasm did not equal the decision."},
{"id":"E23","turn":16,"excerpt":"An on-sale plan. She wanted to see, on paper, what we do on an on-sale morning.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"The specific artifact the decider asked for and we couldn't show."},
{"id":"E24","turn":16,"excerpt":"Who's watching, who she calls, what happens at minute four.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["gaps","language"],"note":"Rep describing the plan contents; 'minute four' echoes the trigger."},
{"id":"E25","turn":16,"excerpt":"We don't have that as a thing. I could have built something with our solutions engineer, and I didn't.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Product/offer gap plus a missed execution step by the rep."},
{"id":"E26","turn":18,"excerpt":"I thought the load test had won it.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"Rep over-weighted technical proof; the decider valued it less."},
{"id":"E27","turn":18,"excerpt":"And a ticketing reference.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Second unmet ask: a peer reference from ticketing."},
{"id":"E28","turn":18,"excerpt":"we ran a huge on-sale and here's who picked up.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep (hypothetical reference wording)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Rep's imagined reference statement, not words the customer or a reference said."},
{"id":"E29","turn":18,"excerpt":"I had logos. I didn't have a person.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Reference gap mirrors the buyer's 'person, not queue' need."},
{"id":"E30","turn":20,"excerpt":"Ben presented them to her.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decider"],"note":"Technical proof reached the decider only secondhand, through the CTO."},
{"id":"E31","turn":20,"excerpt":"good.","label":"quote","speaker":"Halima (COO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decided"],"note":"Decider's minimal response shows load test results didn't move her."},
{"id":"E32","turn":22,"excerpt":"A name, not a queue.","label":"quote","speaker":"customer (speaker not specified)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Core customer framing of the need."},
{"id":"E33","turn":22,"excerpt":"On-sale morning","label":"quote","speaker":"customer (speaker not specified)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer's recurring term for the critical moment."},
{"id":"E34","turn":22,"excerpt":"Someone who picks up.","label":"quote","speaker":"customer (speaker not specified)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer wants human responsiveness, not SLAs."},
{"id":"E35","turn":22,"excerpt":"I don't buy uptime, I buy what happens when it's down.","label":"quote","speaker":"Halima (COO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","message","decided"],"note":"Decider explicitly rejects our uptime-led message."},
{"id":"E36","turn":22,"excerpt":"Nobody said \"support.\" They said \"who.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Our category word 'support' was absent from the customer's vocabulary."},
{"id":"E37","turn":24,"excerpt":"We were the better platform. Ben would tell you that today.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Rep's unverified claim; the decider judged on a different criterion."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E21","E15","E13"],"what":"Rep says we were the favourite right up to Halima's 'queue' comment, yet the customer's questions had already turned to 'who' after the competitor meeting."},
{"evidence":["E26","E31","E35"],"what":"Rep thought the load test had won it, but the decider answered the results with only 'good' and said she doesn't buy uptime."},
{"evidence":["E22","E8","E7"],"what":"Rep cites Ben planning the integration as a sign of winning, but Ben was not the decider; Halima decided alone in one meeting."},
{"evidence":["E37","E35","E20"],"what":"Rep's claim that we were the better platform conflicts with the decider's criterion: what happens when it's down, not platform quality."},
{"evidence":["E17","E19","E20"],"what":"Rep describes the pitch as getting a good reaction, but the decider's key question about support got a dismissive answer."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"When did you first feel this was lost? What happened right before?","turn":14,"what":"Rep points to Halima's 'queue' sentence, ignoring the earlier shift in questions after the competitor meeting (T10)."},
{"question":"Why not?","turn":18,"what":"Rep gives a brief reason ('I thought the load test had won it') and then moves to the reference gap instead of explaining why no on-sale plan was built."},
{"question":"Anything else?","turn":24,"what":"Rep offers an unsupported claim about platform superiority, attributed to the losing champion, rather than new evidence."},
{"question":"What did the customer bring up about the competitor?","turn":8,"what":"The competitor is never named, and the rep mixes in his own unverified theory that they over-promised."}
],
"skipped":[],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"A name, not a queue / who's my person","ours":"support plans, the tiers, the response times","evidence":["E32","E18","E19"]},
{"theirs":"I buy what happens when it's down","ours":"uptime history","evidence":["E35","E17"]},
{"theirs":"who","ours":"support","evidence":["E36"]},
{"theirs":"Someone who picks up","ours":"response times","evidence":["E34","E19"]},
{"theirs":"On-sale morning","ours":"load test / throughput, queueing, bots","evidence":["E33","E16","E15"]},
{"theirs":"so it's a queue with a faster timer","ours":"support plans, the tiers, the response times","evidence":["E20","E19"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E7","E8"],"what":"Lost: Halima (COO) chose the competitor in one meeting, overruling Ben (CTO), who wanted us."},
{"evidence":["E9"],"what":"Loss was formalized by an official email; Ben called the rep before it went out."},
{"evidence":["E4"],"what":"The whole payments business was being replaced before the spring on-sales; nothing indicates that only part of the business moved."},
{"evidence":["E10","E11"],"what":"Competitor won on named people and a promise of on-call coverage for every major on-sale."},
{"evidence":["E37"],"what":"Rep maintains we had the better platform (opinion), which did not change the outcome."}
]}

contradictions.what: Rep says we were the favourite right up to Halima's 'queue' comment, yet the customer's questions had already turned to 'who' after the competitor meeting.
Rep thought the load test had won it, but the decider answered the results with only 'good' and said she doesn't buy uptime.
Rep cites Ben planning the integration as a sign of winning, but Ben was not the decider; Halima decided alone in one meeting.
Rep's claim that we were the better platform conflicts with the decider's criterion: what happens when it's down, not platform quality.
Rep describes the pitch as getting a good reaction, but the decider's key question about support got a dismissive answer.

dodges.question: Anything else?

dodges.what: The competitor is never named, and the rep mixes in his own unverified theory that they over-promised.

outcome_signals.what: Lost: Halima (COO) chose the competitor in one meeting, overruling Ben (CTO), who wanted us.

Competitor won on named people and a promise of on-call coverage for every major on-sale.
Rep maintains we had the better platform (opinion), which did not change the outcome.
